record.title: Crownhill: the meeting battle
record.deeds: fought enemy spears, enemy swords and enemy horse; lost 28 men and killed 36; was shot at by enemy archers, losing 1 man; cut down 7 of the fleeing enemy, then broke and fled from enemy archers, losing 14 more in flight
orders: advance on the enemy. No rider can get through to Swords: they are not sent it
